page.content:
Desert Bluffs radio host with a permanent smile and a bloody studio.

How Kevin connects

  • Location: Desert Bluffs — Kevin hosts radio from Desert Bluffs.
  • Faction: StrexCorp Synernists Inc. — Kevin speaks StrexCorp's smiling language on Desert Bluffs radio.
  • Character: Cecil Palmer — Kevin is Cecil's Desert Bluffs double and rival host.

What is Kevin?

Kevin is Cecil's Desert Bluffs counterpart, a cheerful host in a red studio who speaks StrexCorp's language and treats Night Vale as a market to be opened.

Key threads lead to Desert Bluffs, StrexCorp Synernists Inc. and Cecil Palmer.
